mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS unitId, u.parent_unit_id AS parentUnitId, u.unit_kind AS unitKind, u.title, u.sort_order AS sortOrder, COALESCE(u.content_text, '') AS contentText FROM edu_course_unit u WHERE u.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} ORDER BY u.sort_order, u.id

SELECT u.id AS unitId, u.parent_unit_id AS parentUnitId, u.unit_kind AS unitKind, u.title, u.sort_order AS sortOrder, COALESCE(u.content_text, '') AS contentText, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_resource r WHERE r.course_space_id = u.course_space_id AND r.status <> 'ARCHIVED' AND r.unit_id IN (SELECT cu.id FROM edu_course_unit cu WHERE cu.course_space_id = u.course_space_id AND (cu.id = u.id OR cu.parent_unit_id = u.id))) AS materialCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_knowledge_point kp WHERE kp.course_space_id = u.course_space_id AND kp.unit_id IN (SELECT cu.id FROM edu_course_unit cu WHERE cu.course_space_id = u.course_space_id AND (cu.id = u.id OR cu.parent_unit_id = u.id))) AS pointCount, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT qkp.question_id) FROM edu_question_knowledge_point qkp JOIN edu_knowledge_point kp ON kp.id = qkp.knowledge_point_id WHERE kp.course_space_id = u.course_space_id AND kp.unit_id IN (SELECT cu.id FROM edu_course_unit cu WHERE cu.course_space_id = u.course_space_id AND (cu.id = u.id OR cu.parent_unit_id = u.id))) AS questionCount, (SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(rp.completed) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) FROM edu_resource_progress rp JOIN edu_resource r ON r.id = rp.resource_id WHERE r.course_space_id = u.course_space_id AND rp.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND r.unit_id IN (SELECT cu.id FROM edu_course_unit cu WHERE cu.course_space_id = u.course_space_id AND (cu.id = u.id OR cu.parent_unit_id = u.id))) AS completionRate FROM edu_course_unit u WHERE u.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} ORDER BY u.sort_order, u.id

SELECT kp.id AS knowledgePointId, kp.unit_id AS unitId, kp.code, kp.name, COALESCE(kp.content_text, '') AS contentText, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT qkp.question_id) FROM edu_question_knowledge_point qkp WHERE qkp.knowledge_point_id = kp.id) AS questionCount FROM edu_knowledge_point kp WHERE kp.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} ORDER BY kp.unit_id, kp.name

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.title, qv.question_kind AS questionKind, qv.difficulty, qv.max_score AS maxScore, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(kp2.name ORDER BY kp2.name SEPARATOR '、') FROM edu_question_knowledge_point qkp2 JOIN edu_knowledge_point kp2 ON kp2.id = qkp2.knowledge_point_id WHERE qkp2.question_id = q.id) AS knowledgePoints FROM edu_question q JOIN edu_question_version qv ON qv.question_id = q.id AND qv.version_no = (SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM edu_question_version v WHERE v.question_id = q.id) WHERE q.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} AND q.status <> 'ARCHIVED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_question_knowledge_point qkp JOIN edu_knowledge_point kp ON kp.id = qkp.knowledge_point_id WHERE qkp.question_id = q.id AND kp.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} AND kp.unit_id IN (SELECT cu.id FROM edu_course_unit cu WHERE cu.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} AND (cu.id = #{unitId} OR cu.parent_unit_id = #{unitId}))) ORDER BY q.created_at DESC, q.id DESC

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.title, qv.question_kind AS questionKind, qv.difficulty, qv.max_score AS maxScore, DATE_FORMAT(q.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS createdAt, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(kp2.name ORDER BY kp2.name SEPARATOR '、') FROM edu_question_knowledge_point qkp2 JOIN edu_knowledge_point kp2 ON kp2.id = qkp2.knowledge_point_id WHERE qkp2.question_id = q.id) AS knowledgePoints FROM edu_question q JOIN edu_question_version qv ON qv.question_id = q.id AND qv.version_no = (SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM edu_question_version v WHERE v.question_id = q.id) JOIN edu_question_knowledge_point qkp ON qkp.question_id = q.id WHERE q.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} AND q.status <> 'ARCHIVED' AND qkp.knowledge_point_id = #{pointId} ORDER BY q.created_at DESC, q.id DESC

SELECT r.id AS resourceId, r.title, r.folder_id AS folderId, r.unit_id AS unitId, r.resource_kind AS resourceKind, r.origin AS origin, r.status AS resourceStatus, r.download_enabled AS downloadEnabled, r.watermark_text AS watermarkText, r.task_enabled AS taskEnabled, r.task_required_seconds AS taskRequiredSeconds, rv.id AS versionId, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.storage_key AS storageKey, rv.external_uri AS externalUri, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, rv.byte_size AS byteSize, rv.processing_status AS processingStatus, DATE_FORMAT(rv.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_resource_page p WHERE p.resource_version_id = rv.id) AS pageCount, rel.id AS releaseId, rel.resource_version_id AS releasedVersionId, srel.id AS studioReleaseId, srel.resource_version_id AS studioVersionId, DATE_FORMAT(rel.opens_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS opensAt, DATE_FORMAT(rel.closes_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS closesAt, rel.ended_at AS endedAt, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM edu_resource_class_release drel WHERE drel.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND drel.resource_id = r.id AND drel.release_source = 'PREPARE' AND drel.ended_at IS NOT NULL AND drel.end_reason = '课前准备删除资料环节') AS removedBefore FROM edu_resource r LEFT JOIN edu_resource_version rv ON rv.resource_id = r.id AND rv.version_no = (SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM edu_resource_version v WHERE v.resource_id = r.id) LEFT JOIN edu_resource_class_release rel ON rel.resource_id = r.id AND rel.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND rel.release_source = 'PREPARE' AND rel.ended_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN edu_resource_class_release srel ON srel.resource_id = r.id AND srel.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND srel.release_source = 'STUDIO' AND srel.ended_at IS NULL WHERE r.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} AND r.status <> 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.id DESC

SELECT r.id AS resourceId, r.title, r.unit_id AS unitId, rv.id AS versionId, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_resource_page p WHERE p.resource_version_id = rv.id) AS pageCount, DATE_FORMAT(rv.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS createdAt FROM edu_resource r JOIN edu_resource_version rv ON rv.resource_id = r.id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.course_space_id = r.course_space_id JOIN edu_class_teacher ct ON ct.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id WHERE b.id = #{bindingId} AND r.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND ct.user_id = #{userId} AND ct.valid_to IS NULL AND ct.can_publish = 1 AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rv.processing_status = 'READY' ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.id DESC, rv.version_no DESC

SELECT rv.id AS versionId, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.storage_key AS storageKey, rv.external_uri AS externalUri, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, rv.byte_size AS byteSize, rv.processing_status AS processingStatus, DATE_FORMAT(rv.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_resource_page p WHERE p.resource_version_id = rv.id) AS pageCount FROM edu_resource_version rv WHERE rv.resource_id = #{resourceId} ORDER BY rv.version_no DESC
SELECT page_no AS pageNo, preview_storage_key AS previewStorageKey, width_px AS widthPx, height_px AS heightPx FROM edu_resource_page WHERE resource_version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY page_no

SELECT rv.id AS versionId, rv.resource_id AS resourceId, rv.resource_kind AS resourceKind, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.storage_key AS storageKey, rv.external_uri AS externalUri, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, rv.byte_size AS byteSize, rv.processing_status AS processingStatus, r.title, r.unit_id AS unitId, r.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, r.download_enabled AS downloadEnabled, r.watermark_text AS watermarkText FROM edu_resource_version rv JOIN edu_resource r ON r.id = rv.resource_id WHERE rv.id = #{versionId} AND r.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId}

SELECT rv.id AS versionId, rv.resource_id AS resourceId, rv.resource_kind AS resourceKind, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.storage_key AS storageKey, rv.external_uri AS externalUri, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, rv.byte_size AS byteSize, rv.processing_status AS processingStatus, r.title, r.unit_id AS unitId, r.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, r.download_enabled AS downloadEnabled, r.watermark_text AS watermarkText, rel.id AS releaseId FROM edu_resource_class_release rel JOIN edu_resource_version rv ON rv.id = rel.resource_version_id JOIN edu_resource r ON r.id = rel.resource_id WHERE rel.id = (SELECT MAX(r2.id) FROM edu_resource_class_release r2 WHERE r2.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND r2.resource_version_id = rv.id AND r2.ended_at IS NULL) AND rel.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND rel.resource_version_id = #{versionId} AND rel.ended_at IS NULL AND rel.opens_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (rel.closes_at IS NULL OR rel.closes_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND rv.processing_status = 'READY' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT rv.id AS versionId, rv.resource_id AS resourceId, rv.resource_kind AS resourceKind, rv.storage_key AS storageKey, rv.external_uri AS externalUri, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, rv.byte_size AS byteSize, rv.processing_status AS processingStatus, r.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, r.title, r.unit_id AS unitId FROM edu_resource_version rv JOIN edu_resource r ON r.id = rv.resource_id WHERE rv.id = #{versionId}

SELECT rel.id AS releaseId, rel.binding_id AS bindingId, rel.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, rel.resource_id AS resourceId, rel.resource_version_id AS resourceVersionId, rel.opens_at AS opensAt, rel.closes_at AS closesAt, rel.ended_at AS endedAt FROM edu_resource_class_release rel WHERE rel.id = #{releaseId}

SELECT rel.id AS releaseId, rel.resource_version_id AS resourceVersionId, rel.release_source AS releaseSource, rel.opens_at AS opensAt, rel.closes_at AS closesAt FROM edu_resource_class_release rel WHERE rel.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND rel.resource_id = #{resourceId} AND rel.release_source = #{source} AND rel.ended_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT origin FROM edu_resource WHERE id = #{resourceId} AND course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId}

INSERT INTO edu_resource_version (resource_id, resource_kind, version_no, storage_key, external_uri, sha256, mime_type, byte_size, processing_status, created_by_user_id) VALUES (#{resourceId}, #{resourceKind}, #{versionNo}, #{storageKey}, #{externalUri}, #{sha256}, #{mimeType}, #{byteSize}, #{processingStatus}, #{userId})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS resourceId, r.title, r.course_space_id AS courseSpaceId, r.download_enabled AS downloadEnabled, r.watermark_text AS watermarkText, r.task_enabled AS taskEnabled, r.task_required_seconds AS taskRequiredSeconds, rv.byte_size AS byteSize FROM edu_resource r LEFT JOIN edu_resource_version rv ON rv.resource_id = r.id AND rv.id = (SELECT MAX(v.id) FROM edu_resource_version v WHERE v.resource_id = r.id) WHERE r.id = #{resourceId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_resource_class_release rel WHERE rel.resource_id = r.id AND rel.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND rel.ended_at IS NULL )

SELECT resource_id AS resourceId, watched_seconds AS watchedSeconds, completed, DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS completedAt FROM edu_resource_progress WHERE binding_id = #{bindingId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT p.topic_id AS topicId, COUNT(*) AS postCount FROM edu_discussion_post p JOIN edu_discussion_topic t ON t.id = p.topic_id WHERE t.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'NORMAL' GROUP BY p.topic_id

SELECT a.id AS assignmentId, a.title AS assignmentTitle, DATE_FORMAT(a.answer_opens_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS answerVisibleAt, ai.id AS assignmentItemId, ai.sort_order AS sortOrder, ai.prompt, ai.max_score AS maxScore, qv.id AS questionVersionId, qv.question_kind AS questionKind, qv.options_json AS optionsJson, qv.answer_json AS answerJson, qv.explanation, qv.difficulty, qv.tags, sa.answer_json AS studentAnswerJson, DATE_FORMAT(sv.submitted_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS submittedAt, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(kp.name ORDER BY kp.name SEPARATOR ',') FROM edu_question_knowledge_point qkp JOIN edu_knowledge_point kp ON kp.id = qkp.knowledge_point_id AND kp.course_space_id = qkp.course_space_id WHERE qkp.question_id = qv.question_id) AS knowledgePoints FROM edu_assignment a JOIN edu_assignment_target t ON t.assignment_id = a.id AND t.student_user_id = #{userId} JOIN edu_assignment_submission s ON s.target_id = t.id JOIN edu_submission_version sv ON sv.submission_id = s.id AND sv.superseded_at IS NULL JOIN edu_submission_answer sa ON sa.submission_version_id = sv.id JOIN edu_assignment_item ai ON ai.id = sa.assignment_item_id AND ai.assignment_id = a.id LEFT JOIN edu_question_version qv ON qv.id = ai.question_version_id WHERE a.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND a.assignment_kind = 'PREVIEW' AND t.target_status = 'REQUIRED' AND a.answer_opens_at IS NOT NULL AND a.answer_opens_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY sv.submitted_at DESC, a.id DESC, ai.sort_order
SELECT n.id, n.binding_id AS bindingId, n.content, DATE_FORMAT(n.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS updatedAt FROM edu_student_note n WHERE n.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND n.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_student_note (binding_id, user_id, content, updated_at) VALUES (#{bindingId}, #{userId}, #{content}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE content = VALUES(content), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT p.resource_id AS resourceId, COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) AS learnerCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.completed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, AVG(p.watched_seconds) AS avgWatchedSeconds FROM edu_resource_progress p WHERE p.binding_id = #{bindingId} GROUP BY p.resource_id

SELECT a.id AS assignmentId, COUNT(t.id) AS targetCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS submittedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN sv.is_late = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lateCount FROM edu_assignment a JOIN edu_assignment_target t ON t.assignment_id = a.id AND t.target_status = 'REQUIRED' LEFT JOIN edu_assignment_submission s ON s.target_id = t.id LEFT JOIN edu_submission_version sv ON sv.submission_id = s.id AND sv.superseded_at IS NULL WHERE a.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND a.assignment_kind = 'PREVIEW' AND a.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY a.id

SELECT p.topic_id AS topicId, p.user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS postCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.parent_post_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS replyCount, SUM(p.like_count) AS likeCount, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(p.created_at), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS lastPostAt FROM edu_discussion_post p JOIN edu_discussion_topic t ON t.id = p.topic_id AND t.binding_id = p.binding_id WHERE p.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'NORMAL' GROUP BY p.topic_id, p.user_id

SELECT a.id AS assignmentId, a.title AS assignmentTitle, a.assignment_kind AS assignmentKind, t.id AS targetId, t.student_user_id AS studentUserId, ai.id AS assignmentItemId, ai.sort_order AS sortOrder, ai.prompt, ai.max_score AS maxScore, qv.id AS questionVersionId, qv.question_kind AS questionKind, qv.options_json AS optionsJson, qv.answer_json AS answerJson, qv.explanation, qv.difficulty, qv.tags, sa.answer_json AS studentAnswerJson, sv.id AS submissionVersionId, DATE_FORMAT(sv.submitted_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS submittedAt, sv.is_late AS isLate, CASE WHEN a.answer_opens_at IS NOT NULL AND a.answer_opens_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS answerVisible, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(kp.name ORDER BY kp.name SEPARATOR ',') FROM edu_question_knowledge_point qkp JOIN edu_knowledge_point kp ON kp.id = qkp.knowledge_point_id AND kp.course_space_id = qkp.course_space_id WHERE qkp.question_id = qv.question_id) AS knowledgePoints FROM edu_assignment a JOIN edu_assignment_target t ON t.assignment_id = a.id AND t.target_status = 'REQUIRED' JOIN edu_assignment_submission s ON s.target_id = t.id JOIN edu_submission_version sv ON sv.submission_id = s.id AND sv.superseded_at IS NULL JOIN edu_submission_answer sa ON sa.submission_version_id = sv.id JOIN edu_assignment_item ai ON ai.id = sa.assignment_item_id AND ai.assignment_id = a.id LEFT JOIN edu_question_version qv ON qv.id = ai.question_version_id WHERE a.binding_id = #{bindingId} ORDER BY sv.submitted_at DESC, t.student_user_id, a.id, ai.sort_order LIMIT 500

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_assignment a JOIN edu_assignment_target t ON t.assignment_id = a.id AND t.target_status = 'REQUIRED' JOIN edu_assignment_submission s ON s.target_id = t.id JOIN edu_submission_version sv ON sv.submission_id = s.id AND sv.superseded_at IS NULL JOIN edu_submission_answer sa ON sa.submission_version_id = sv.id JOIN edu_assignment_item ai ON ai.id = sa.assignment_item_id AND ai.assignment_id = a.id WHERE a.binding_id = #{bindingId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edu_resource_progress (resource_id, course_space_id, binding_id, user_id, watched_seconds, completed, completed_at) VALUES (#{resourceId}, #{courseSpaceId}, #{bindingId}, #{userId}, #{watchedSeconds}, #{completed}, #{completedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE watched_seconds = GREATEST(watched_seconds, VALUES(watched_seconds)), completed = GREATEST(completed, VALUES(completed)), completed_at = COALESCE(completed_at, VALUES(completed_at))

SELECT r.id AS resourceId, r.title, r.unit_id AS unitId, r.folder_id AS folderId, f.name AS folderName, r.download_enabled AS downloadEnabled, r.watermark_text AS watermarkText, r.task_enabled AS taskEnabled, r.task_required_seconds AS taskRequiredSeconds, rv.id AS versionId, rv.version_no AS versionNo, rv.resource_kind AS resourceKind, rv.storage_key AS storageKey, rv.mime_type AS mimeType, rv.byte_size AS byteSize, rel.id AS releaseId, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name) AS creatorName, DATE_FORMAT(rv.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS createdAt, DATE_FORMAT(rel.opens_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS opensAt, DATE_FORMAT(rel.closes_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS closesAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edu_resource_page p WHERE p.resource_version_id = rv.id) AS pageCount FROM edu_resource_class_release rel JOIN edu_resource r ON r.id = rel.resource_id JOIN edu_resource_version rv ON rv.id = rel.resource_version_id JOIN edu_course_class_binding b ON b.id = rel.binding_id JOIN edu_class_student st ON st.teaching_class_id = b.teaching_class_id LEFT JOIN edu_resource_folder f ON f.id = r.folder_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = rel.released_by_user_id WHERE rel.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND rel.ended_at IS NULL
AND rel.release_source IN ('STUDIO', 'BOTH')
AND rel.release_source IN ('PREPARE', 'BOTH')
AND rel.opens_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND (rel.closes_at IS NULL OR rel.closes_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) AND rv.processing_status = 'READY' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.ended_at IS NULL AND st.user_id = #{userId} AND st.left_at IS NULL ORDER BY rel.opens_at DESC, rel.id DESC

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.title, q.folder_id AS folderId, q.status, COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name) AS creatorName, qv.id AS versionId, qv.version_no AS versionNo, qv.question_kind AS questionKind, qv.stem, qv.options_json AS optionsJson, qv.answer_json AS answerJson, qv.explanation, qv.difficulty, qv.tags, qv.max_score AS maxScore, DATE_FORMAT(qv.created_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS createdAt, s.id AS shareId, s.status AS shareStatus, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(kp.name ORDER BY kp.name SEPARATOR '、') FROM edu_question_knowledge_point qkp JOIN edu_knowledge_point kp ON kp.id = qkp.knowledge_point_id WHERE qkp.question_id = q.id) AS knowledgePoints FROM edu_question q JOIN edu_question_version qv ON qv.question_id = q.id AND qv.version_no = (SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM edu_question_version v WHERE v.question_id = q.id) LEFT JOIN edu_question_share s ON s.question_version_id = qv.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = q.created_by_user_id WHERE q.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId} AND q.status <> 'ARCHIVED' ORDER BY q.created_at DESC, q.id DESC

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.title, q.status, qv.id AS versionId, s.id AS shareId, s.status AS shareStatus FROM edu_question q JOIN edu_question_version qv ON qv.question_id = q.id AND qv.version_no = (SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM edu_question_version v WHERE v.question_id = q.id) LEFT JOIN edu_question_share s ON s.question_version_id = qv.id WHERE q.id = #{questionId} AND q.course_space_id = #{courseSpaceId}

'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS opensAt, DATE_FORMAT(a.closes_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS closesAt, NULL AS removedAt, '撤回预习任务' AS reason FROM edu_assignment a WHERE a.binding_id = #{bindingId} AND a.assignment_kind = 'PREVIEW' AND a.status = 'ARCHIVED' UNION ALL SELECT 'PLAN' AS kind, p.id AS stageId, p.title, l.title AS subtitle, NULL AS opensAt, NULL AS closesAt, DATE_FORMAT(p.created_at, 'ARCHIVED' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'MATERIAL' AS kind, r.id AS stageId, r.title, NULL AS subtitle, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(rel.opens_at), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.000Z') AS opensAt,
